The board reads about forty papers a quarter. Yours asks. A paper that asks gets a discussion; a proposal gets a vote. I would suggest that the first line say what you want decided.
So instead of "we would like the authority to be raised", the line reads: it is proposed that the authority be raised to thirty-five million, subject to approval of the treaty.
That is the paper. Second point: your third safeguard sits in section three, where nobody reads it. The board requires that any expiry date appear in the recommendation itself.

A board paper either gets decided or it gets deferred, and the difference is usually not the substance. It is whether the recommendation can be voted on exactly as it is written. My test is simple. Can the chair read your recommendation aloud, word for word, and call for a vote on it? If the answer is no, the item will be discussed and then held over. Papers that ask for support are the ones that come back. Papers that propose a specific action, in a single sentence, are the ones that get decided. The second thing I would say is about safeguards. People put them at the end, as though they were a weakness to be disclosed. Put them in the recommendation. A board that can see the limit of what it is approving approves faster, not more slowly. And write a date on everything, including the day the authority ends.

The first time somebody sent back a draft of mine with be revised instead of is revised, I assumed it was their mistake. I very nearly corrected it back. In my own language the subjunctive is loud: you hear it in the ending of the verb. In English it hides. Nothing is added, something is taken away. The final s disappears, and the sentence looks like a typing error to anyone who learned English by ear. It took me a long time to trust it. What changed was noticing where it appears. Nobody says it in a corridor. It lives in papers, in minutes, in anything that will be read by people who were not in the room, and that is exactly the writing that decides things. When I started using it, the tone of the replies changed before the content did. The same recommendation, in that register, stopped being received as a request.
